effect_description_eng: [When Moving] [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Veedramon] in its text or the [Royal Knight] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon with [Veedramon] in its name would leave the battle area by your opponent's effects, by suspending it, it doesn't leave.
